_README: Legafy AI tenant registry. Every key except '_README' is an internal tenant label of your choosing (not shown to the tenant). Each entry must set 'token_sha256' to the hex SHA-256 digest of that tenant's bearer token -- NEVER store the raw token in a production registry. To mint a new token: run `openssl rand -hex 24` to generate it, hand that value to the tenant once over a secure channel, then run `printf %s "$TOKEN" | shasum -a 256` and paste the resulting hex digest into 'token_sha256'. A raw 'token' field is also accepted as a fallback, but is intended for local development only -- tenancy.py prefers 'token_sha256' when both are present. 'rate_limit_per_minute', 'monthly_quota' and 'scopes' are optional per-tenant overrides of the TIER_DEFAULTS for the given 'tier'; omit any of them to inherit the tier default. 'expires_on' is an ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); tokens are rejected once that date has passed.
